scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title song before Xin Huimei confronts her manager about Yuanye Records.

scenes.title: See You in Court
scenes.summary: Xin Huimei confronts her manager for secretly trying to gather breach-of-contract footage at Xingtian, announces her lawyers have filed suit, and vows to see Yuanye Records in court.

scenes.title: Leaked Graduate Photo
scenes.summary: An old college acquaintance tracks down Chun Yuqiao's 2006 Media College graduation photo online and asks Bu Xiaogu to meet that evening.

scenes.title: No Need to Clarify
scenes.summary: Leaving work early, Bu Xiaogu urges Chun Yuqiao to deny the online slander against him, but Yuqiao insists nobody cares about a producer and refuses to stir up trouble before the live finale.

scenes.title: Letting Go for Good
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu confronts her ex-boyfriend for posting Chun Yuqiao's college photo online, tells him they broke up two years ago and she simply admires Yuqiao's work, and parts ways for good.

scenes.title: The Final Thesis Deadline
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu promises Professor Fang she will finish the last chapter of her thesis tonight and hand it in tomorrow, and Fang warns that tomorrow is the absolute final deadline.

scenes.title: A Seat in the Press Row
scenes.summary: A studio crew member seats reporter Bianbian in the packed media row before the finale, and Bianbian jokes that Xin Huimei's feud only stayed in the headlines thanks to a hacker's leaked photo.

scenes.title: On Duty at the Artist Entrance
scenes.summary: After greeting Li Mingji's manager backstage, Lin Jie tells Bu Xiaogu that Kaiwen barred first-year rookies from the VIP corridor, until Xiaogu reminds her of her spotless work and wins permission.

scenes.title: Websites Overloaded
scenes.summary: Kaiwen and Xingzi watch Xin Huimei's fans flood Yuanye's website for seven hours, agree Xingtian was spared only because Chun Yuqiao kept silent, and worry about Yuqiao's pale face and stomach pain.

scenes.title: This Is Your Dressing Room
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao spots Bu Xiaogu on the backstage monitor and orders Kaiwen to replace her near Li Mingji, right as Xiaogu welcomes the veteran singer to his dressing room.

scenes.title: Staying in the Control Room
scenes.summary: Blocked by Stella's two-week PR policy from greeting artists backstage, Chun Yuqiao stays to direct from the control room and silences a hallway dispute while Bu Xiaogu fetches Li Mingji's medicine.
scenes.location: Studio One corridor and medical station

scenes.title: Medicine Before Going Onstage
scenes.summary: Bu Xiaogu delivers Li Mingji's medicine, reassures the nervous star before the live broadcast, apologises with a crew member after an interruption, and worries when Li Mingji mixes pills.

scenes.title: Clearing the Stage Passage
scenes.summary: Backstage crew clear the stage entrance corridor and sweep away a stray ornament before the live broadcast starts.

scenes.title: Emergency on Finale Night
scenes.summary: Host Wen Simo welcomes viewers to the live Twelve Singers finale and introduces mystery guest Li Mingji; after Li Mingji collapses onstage, Chun Yuqiao steps in to defend Bu Xiaogu.

scenes.title: Questioning at the Station
scenes.summary: Questioned overnight after Li Mingji's sudden heart attack onstage, Bu Xiaogu explains she had nothing to do with his medication while Chun Yuqiao orders a thorough investigation.

scenes.title: The Secret of Stage Fright
scenes.summary: At the hospital, Li Mingji's manager threatens to sue Xingtian even after the singer is revived, until Chun Yuqiao reveals Li Mingji's hidden stage fright and his lucky stage gemstone.

scenes.title: Withdrawing the Police Report
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao explains that missing the stage gemstone triggered Li Mingji's panic, cites Studio One security footage, and compels the manager to drop the police case and free Bu Xiaogu.

scenes.title: Morning Statement and Emergency Meeting
scenes.summary: After Bu Xiaogu is cleared to leave the station, Xingzi reports that Li Mingji's team withdrew the case and called the incident an accident on Weibo just as DTS executives arrive for an early meeting.

scenes.title: A Major Public Relations Crisis
scenes.summary: While Xiaoye whispers that Twelve Singers is paused for review and DTS executives are meeting inside, PR director Stella dismisses Bu Xiaogu on the spot over the public-relations crisis.

scenes.title: Luckily I Still Have You
scenes.summary: Qin Xiao finds Bu Xiaogu after she misses her thesis deadline during a night at the police station, comforts her over losing her degree and her job, and reminds her nothing keeps Xiaogu down.

scenes.title: Junior Administrative Assistant
scenes.summary: Refusing to leave television behind after taking a cheap-rent flyer outside campus, Bu Xiaogu returns to Xingtian to accept an entry-level job handling general office chores as a junior admin assistant.
scenes.location: street outside campus and HR office

scenes.title: The Department Takes Responsibility
scenes.summary: When a DTS supervisor demands accountability for last week's broadcast accident and Stella blames an intern, Chun Yuqiao insists Unit One has no interns and takes full responsibility himself.

scenes.title: Iced Americano With No Sugar
scenes.summary: Now stationed at Xingtian as a DTS assistant, Qin Xiao acts surprised to see classmate Bu Xiaogu in administration and orders daily black tea and an unsweetened iced Americano while Kaiwen accepts the challenge.

scenes.title: Freshly Brewed Coffee
scenes.summary: One month into her admin job, Bu Xiaogu reflects on facing workplace trials with a steady expression, wins Xiaoye's praise for her coffee, and heads to serve drinks at the ten o'clock production meeting.

scenes.title: Starting Three Shifts
scenes.summary: At the company-wide Star Night launch meeting, Qin Xiao outlines the hundred-thirty-person joint broadcast team under Chun Yuqiao, and Yuqiao steps forward with a solution when other units object.

scenes.title: Closing Credits Song
scenes.summary: Closing song after Chun Yuqiao offers a plan to resolve the staffing dispute.
